fastboot.min.mjs / fastboot.min.mjs.map
  Package : android-fastboot 1.1.3 (npm)   https://www.npmjs.com/package/android-fastboot
  Source  : https://github.com/kdrag0n/fastboot.js
  Author  : Danny Lin <danny@kdrag0n.dev>
  License : MIT (see LICENSE.fastboot.js.txt)
  Vendored: 2026-08-29, byte-identical to dist/fastboot.min.mjs from the npm tarball. NOT modified.

The installer only uses the library's public API (connect, getVariable, runCommand,
upload, reboot). It deliberately does NOT use flashBlob(): that method sizes its
sparse splits from the bootloader's max-download-size (up to 1 GiB), and the HiBy
M500's USB gadget wedges on big super transfers. The 64 MiB sparse chunking lives in
../flasher.js instead.

To update: download a newer dist/fastboot.min.mjs (+ .map) from the npm tarball,
replace these two files, and bump the version above. Keep the LICENSE file.
